description: Returns one vote by its identifier (31510), with the choice of each member (yes, no, or absent), grouped by faction, with the count of each choice in each faction. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

id.description: The identifier, from a search or a list, for example 32449.

name: parliament_get_vote

absent.description: The count of members who did not vote.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the data, RFC 3339.

date.description: The day of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

factions.description: The members by faction, the largest first. A faction with an empty name holds the members of no faction.

members.description: The members of the faction, by family name.

name.description: The family name and the first name.
The faction, in Georgian. Empty for the members of no faction.

other.description: The count of any other choice.

name.description: The name at the Parliament, in Georgian.

quorum.description: The count of yes that the item needs.

reading.description: The reading: first_reading, second_reading, third_reading, single_reading, plenary_draft, alternative_proposal, or other.

name.description: The name at the Parliament, in Georgian.

registration_number.description: The registration number of the package.

source.description: The source of the data: Parliament of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the Parliament did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

url.description: The page of the bill at the Parliament.

title: Get a plenary vote of the Parliament of Georgia
